articles.title: Former Durham police officer facing additional charges in historic sex assault investigation
articles.summary: The province’s police watchdog has laid additional charges against a former Durham Regional Police Service officer in a decades‑old sexual assault investigation. The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) says Kevin Seamons faces an additional five charges in connection with the alleged sexual assault of another woman between May 1999 and December 2009. articles.title: Man in life-threatening condition after hit-and-run in Oshawa
articles.summary: A man is in life-threatening condition after a hit-and-run in north Oshawa on Thursday afternoon, Durham police say.

articles.title: Man, 44, charged in voyeurism investigation in Markham
articles.summary: A 44-year-old Bradford man is facing voyeurism charges following an investigation in Markham. articles.title: 2 people, including 15-year-old, facing multiple charges after gunshot fired at U.S. consulate in Toronto
articles.summary: Two people have been arrested and are now facing a host of charges after a gunshot hit the U.S. consulate in downtown Toronto last week, police say.

articles.title: Police watchdog investigating fatal officer-involved crash, shooting in Mississauga
articles.summary: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating the death of a 19-year-old man after an officer-involved crash and shooting in Mississauga early Thursday morning.

articles.title: Mississauga man charged following sudden death of Cambridge man after taking part in 'healing experience'
articles.summary: Police in Waterloo region have arrested and charged a Mississauga man in the death of a Cambridge man last month. Police say the Cambridge man took part in a private ibogaine healing experience. Ibogaine is a psychoactive alkaloid that is not authorized for use in Canada.
